recognize_zh: 低倍體液細胞塊中，數團鬆散細胞裡的大型細胞核呈棕色 MUM1 陽性，與較小的藍色陰性淋巴球混雜；背景亦有散在的單一陽性大細胞。
features: Low-power cell block with several loose aggregates and scattered single cells
Nuclear MUM1 positivity in the larger tumor cells within aggregates and singly dispersed
Admixed small MUM1-negative lymphocytes with blue nuclei
Clean background without significant non-specific staining
describe_en: Low-power MUM1 (IRF4) immunohistochemistry on an effusion cell block shows multiple loose aggregates and scattered single cells in which the larger neoplastic cells display nuclear positivity, intermixed with smaller negative reactive lymphocytes. The distribution indicates that the large-cell population in the effusion carries a plasmablastic, MUM1-positive phenotype. In conjunction with HHV8/LANA positivity and lack of B-cell and immunoglobulin expression, findings are consistent with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, sparse and HHV8-negative, unlike the large atypical MUM1+ population here.
Shares MUM1 positivity and CD20 loss but is HHV8/LANA-negative.
HHV8-negative, often CD20-positive, and seen in elderly patients without immunodeficiency.
